data.host: The ip-address of your SAJ Inverter modbus device
data.name: The prefix to be used for your SAJ Inverter sensors
data.port: The TCP port on which to connect to the SAJ Inverter
data.scan_interval: The polling frequency of the modbus registers in seconds

error.invalid_scan_interval: Scan interval must be at least 60 seconds

data.mqtt_publish_all: Publish all sensors on main interval
data.use_ha_mqtt: Use Home Assistant MQTT (ignores host/port settings)

data_description.fast_enabled: Polls the key energy sensors every 10 seconds and updates the Home Assistant entities. Switched off automatically while Ultra Fast is active.
data_description.ultra_fast_enabled: The 1-second resolution is published over MQTT only. While this is active the 10s loop is switched off, so Home Assistant entities fall back to the main scan interval and PV1/PV2 power is not polled at all.
